message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the case.

Facts: Employee (security guard) stole chips from company, value 359,076 RMB, sold for 59,000 (but value is high). This is theft (盗窃). No other crimes like fraud, etc. He used his position to take property. So charge: 盗窃.

Check if any other label applies: maybe "职务侵占"? That is for misappropriation by a person in a position of trust, but usually for employees who appropriate property they are entrusted with, but theft is still theft. In examples, similar case of stealing trees was labeled 盗窃; illegal hunting etc. So just 盗窃.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
